title: Implement durable workflow state machine
businessObjective: Advance Phase 3 — Durable event and workflow layer through one bounded workflow-runtime outcome.
technicalObjective: Implement a durable workflow state machine with explicit analysis, proposal, policy, approval, provider-wait, timeout, cancellation, recovery, execution, verification, and outcome states.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow persists proposal, policy, approval, provider-wait, execution, verification, timeout, cancellation, recovery, and terminal states independently of the provider process.
Every provider state available, busy, rate_limited, capacity_exhausted, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable, and disabled has deterministic fail-closed transition behavior.
Non-available providers pause or safely requeue work, record the reason, and never authorize or execute production changes.
The AI provider cannot advance policy or approval state.
Unknown or saturated quota state blocks/pause-requeues work before provider or executor invocation and never shares booking-path capacity.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P3-003 --base origin/main --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: durable workflow and provider-state transition validation
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the workflow-runtime branch and generated artifacts; preserve audit and verification evidence.
